title: GHSL AI-agent index lists mutable-ref TOCTOU in MongoDB Node driver release workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: A maintainer-approved release workflow checks out the pull-request head by mutable ref and runs its scripts with a token granting contents and pull-request writes, so the contributor can update code after authorization.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index includes this advisory in its AI-discovered list. The item advisory credits only Jaroslav Lobačevski and does not explain agent involvement; attribution is index-level only.
classification_note: The primary advisory documents the race and fix; no exploitation in the wild is claimed.
remediation_note: Fixed in PR #5043 on 2026-09-03. The workflow must be triggered by a maintainer.
